item.text: {"reviews":[{"benchmark":"arc","instrument_review":"MESA supports interpreting ARC-AGI-2 scores as performance on unfamiliar grid puzzles under specified evaluation conditions. Public scoring tests, human difficulty studies and documented revisions support inspection. Broader reasoning claims, repeated-run uncertainty and comparability after corrections remain insufficiently established.","supported_claims":["The benchmark assesses solving new grid problems from worked examples.","Official scoring averages the fraction of new inputs solved within each problem.","Human study results informed selection of test sets with similar human difficulty.","Public marking tests check several correct and incorrect output cases."],"documented_problems":["Verified evaluations use one run rather than averaging repeated runs.","Some coloured squares and unclear examples required corrections.","Recorded corrections do not include recalculation of every affected AI score.","A fractional problem score differs from the dataset description of a fully solved problem."],"missing_information":["Repeated-run score variation and uncertainty estimates for AI comparisons.","Systematic tests of changes to instructions, presentation and software.","Evidence connecting scores to performance beyond grid puzzles.","Effects of benchmark corrections on historical score comparisons."],"reinterpretations":["An AI score describes the evaluated system under its recorded settings and spending limit.","Reasoning is operationalized as inferring transformations between two-dimensional grids.","A problem score can represent partial success across inputs, although each individual output requires an exact match."],"closing_note":"The distinction between a fully solved problem and the software's fractional problem score needs clear reporting. The supplied description also combines public-test review with rules whose application depends on the evaluation route.","mesa_answers":[{"id":1,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The version, public test set and official scoring method are identified."},{"id":2,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Rule inference, intended AI systems and comparison uses are described."},{"id":3,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Worked grid pairs, new inputs and required output grids are described."},{"id":4,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Attempts, verified settings, spending limits and evaluation-route differences are described."},{"id":5,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Exact matching, within-problem fractions and averaging are explained."},{"id":6,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Inferring new transformations from examples is linked to the intended reasoning ability."},{"id":7,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Puzzle sources, review and human difficulty matching are explained; coverage of broader reasoning is less justified."},{"id":8,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Developer review, human solving and subsequent corrections support checking, but complete answer-checking coverage is unclear."},{"id":9,"choice":"Partly","comment":"The tasks cover grid-based rule inference; coverage of broader reasoning claims is unestablished."},{"id":10,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Exact matching reflects successful grid completion, but does not establish the reasoning process used."},{"id":11,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"The averaging rule is described without evidence justifying its interpretation as an ability measure."},{"id":12,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Public tests examine correct outputs, wrong sizes, changed squares and missing outputs; coverage is limited."},{"id":13,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Human results inform difficulty and AI results provide comparisons, but the human study covers a larger puzzle pool."},{"id":14,"choice":"No","comment":"Verified testing explicitly uses one run; repeated-run variation is not measured there."},{"id":15,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Changeable software settings do not establish that effects of changing conditions were tested."},{"id":16,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"No score-variation estimates or ranges are supplied for the comparisons."},{"id":17,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Developers investigated repeated solution rules and resistance to program search; these checks do not exclude every shortcut."},{"id":18,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Hidden-data handling agreements and exposure monitoring address risk, but public exposure and possible leakage remain."},{"id":19,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Development training is allowed, evaluation-specific adaptation is discouraged and feedback-based repeated improvement is restricted."},{"id":20,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"No supplied study links grid scores to broader real-world performance."},{"id":21,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Verified settings and human difficulty matching help, but other evaluation routes can differ."},{"id":22,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Public problems, software and marking tests permit inspection; hidden materials and the complete output archive were not examined."},{"id":23,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Public licensing and hidden-data confidentiality, provider handling and review rules are stated."},{"id":24,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Dated corrections and code changes are recorded, but their effects on all earlier scores are not established."},{"id":25,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Grid-task findings are supported; connections to broader intelligence exceed the supplied validation."}]},{"benchmark":"designqa","instrument_review":"MESA supports using DesignQA to examine performance on its specified engineering-document tasks. Practical source materials and documented setup experiments provide useful evidence. Uneven task coverage, scoring artifacts, unequal information supplies and incomplete reproduction records limit broader competence claims and close model comparisons.","supported_claims":["DesignQA contains 1,451 question-answer pairs across six engineering task groups.","Questions use a competition rulebook, vehicle materials and test data.","The authors examined changes to passages, dimension labels, scale bars and highlighted images.","Results describe AI systems together with their supplied or retrieved information."],"documented_problems":["Question groups are highly uneven, including 1,192 individual-rule questions and 16 performance questions.","Formatting and valid rules missing from reference answers can affect credit.","Systems receive different information supplies.","All described scale-bar drawings comply, permitting an always-yes strategy to earn decision credit on that portion.","A released answer file has fewer rows than the corresponding paper question count.","Historical software, settings and inputs are not fully linked to every reported result."],"missing_information":["A complete validation of marking accuracy and consistency.","Repeated evaluations under identical conditions and uncertainty adequate for close comparisons.","Clear training and repeated-submission rules, exposure checks and protected-test arrangements.","Complete reproduction records, reuse rules and explanations of revision effects on scores.","Evidence that scores predict performance on other technical documents or engineering projects."],"reinterpretations":["Engineering understanding is represented by six task groups based on one competition rulebook.","Reported AI performance includes the effects of retrieval and information supply.","Credit can reflect wording and formatting as well as engineering correctness.","The overall score equally weights task groups with different sizes and marking methods."],"closing_note":"Overall and group scores need cautious interpretation because their skill meanings are not established. Identical-condition repetition should be distinguished from evaluations using different supplied passages.","mesa_answers":[{"id":1,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The original benchmark, question count, task groups and public scoring software are identified."},{"id":2,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Engineering-document abilities, intended AI systems and comparison uses are described."},{"id":3,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Rules, images, drawings and required text or yes/no responses are described."},{"id":4,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Instructions and settings are described, but complete historical inputs and settings are not linked to every result."},{"id":5,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Task-specific marking methods and equal weighting of six groups are described."},{"id":6,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Tasks are linked to finding, understanding and applying engineering information."},{"id":7,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Practical sources support relevance, but one rulebook and uneven groups have limited representativeness."},{"id":8,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Additional reviewers checked manually written questions, with exceptions and limited explanation checks."},{"id":9,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Six groups cover relevant activities, but the rulebook and task range are limited."},{"id":10,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Correct decisions receive credit, but wording, formatting and reference omissions can distort marks."},{"id":11,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Equal group weighting is described without evidence validating the overall or separate skill interpretations."},{"id":12,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Small marking-test files and examination of scoring problems show testing occurred; complete validation is not established."},{"id":13,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Random guessing and other AIs provide context, but information supplies differ and no engineer baseline is reported."},{"id":14,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Five passage sets change the conditions and do not establish identical-condition repeated testing."},{"id":15,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Effects of passages, dimension labels, scale bars and image highlighting were examined."},{"id":16,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Passage variation provides limited evidence, but uncertainty is insufficient for close main-model comparisons."},{"id":17,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Formatting, wording and retrieval influences were examined, but shortcut testing is incomplete."},{"id":18,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Novelty and possible exposure are discussed, but systematic overlap checks and protected evaluation data are not established."},{"id":19,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Clear training and repeated-submission rules are unavailable in the supplied sources."},{"id":20,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Performance on other documents and engineering projects is not validated."},{"id":21,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Information differences are described, but their effects leave some system comparisons difficult to interpret."},{"id":22,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Public materials support inspection, but do not fully reproduce every reported result."},{"id":23,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"A licence file and complete responsible-reuse rules were not found in the reviewed material."},{"id":24,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Code history identifies revisions, but their effects on scores are not clearly documented."},{"id":25,"choice":"Partly","comment":"The paper acknowledges major limits; broader engineering competence and close rankings require additional evidence."}]}]}
